findingDetails.title: A lone dash bypasses create.sh's unknown-option refusal
findingDetails.case: A caller runs create.sh - Feature, where the standalone '-' is not a supported option.
findingDetails.evidence: The -?* case pattern requires at least one character after the dash. A lone '-' misses that branch, reaches the catch-all that appends it to ARGS, and becomes part of FEATURE_DESCRIPTION. REQ-001 requires any unmatched dash-leading argument to fail. The test covers --goal and --with-goal but has no single-dash case.
findingDetails.userImpact: The malformed option is treated as feature text instead of being refused, so the scaffolder can continue with an unintended title and path.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The parser branch at lines 351-358 establishes the single-token case; the scoped test at lines 59-79 verifies only the multi-character --goal refusal and valid --with-goal path.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reject the exact token '-' as an unmatched option and add a regression case that confirms it exits 1 before creating a spec folder.
findingDetails.claim: REQ-001's unknown-option contract misses the standalone dash because the shell pattern does not match a one-character token.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked the existing --goal regression and --with-goal happy-path test, the declared no- -- end-of-options scope, and the parser's fall-through behavior. Those checks establish coverage for multi-character flags and valid options, but not the standalone dash.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The standalone dash might be intended as positional title text. The phase spec says no caller passes a title beginning with a dash, while REQ-001 explicitly covers unmatched arguments beginning with a dash and contains no lone-dash exception.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Downgrade or resolve if the interface contract explicitly exempts a standalone '-' from option syntax and the accepted title behavior is documented and tested.

checklist_evidence.note: The test proves --goal refusal and --with-goal success but does not cover a standalone dash.
